name: Benaiah
overview: Benaiah was a male descendant of Nebo noted in Scripture for having married a foreign wife, as recorded in Ezra 10:43. There is no tribal affiliation or additional personal details provided about him. His mention centers on this unique attribute related to his family and marriage.
namesAndTitles: The name Benaiah means 'YHWH has built,' reflecting a theologically significant meaning rooted in the Hebrew language. This proper name underscores God's role in establishing or building, though it was not given directly by God according to the record.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly identifies Benaiah as a descendant of Nebo, establishing a direct familial link. Beyond this, no other family relationships are recorded in the biblical text concerning him.
scriptureSignificance: Benaiah's significance in the biblical narrative lies primarily in his inclusion among those who had married foreign wives, a matter addressed in Ezra 10:43 during the post-exilic period. This highlights the community's concern for covenant faithfulness and purity of the Israelite lineage after the return from exile. His mention serves as a reminder of the challenges faced by God's people in maintaining holiness and obedience to His commands.
